title: Bevel privacy
description: One wide charcoal card with 32px corners, lit by a deep green glow along both sides and in its lower corners: a big faint emblem rises from the bottom edge behind a centered white one-line title and a grey paragraph, and a fine dot grid fades in over the emblem as the card enters the window.
notes: an inverted card (foreground colour behind, background colour text): charcoal under light themes, pale under dark ones; the glow mixes chart-2 and chart-5
the emblem is a media slot; empty it is a faint rounded shape
the dot fade is a CSS scroll-driven animation; off under reduced motion
